name: gap-analysis-from-student-work
description: Analyse student work against criteria to identify specific gaps between current performance and learning objectives. Use when reviewing submissions, planning feedback, or diagnosing learning needs.
evidence_sources: Black & Wiliam (1998) — Assessment and Classroom Learning
Hattie & Timperley (2007) — The Power of Feedback
Sadler (1989) — Formative assessment and the design of instructional systems
Heritage (2010) — Formative Assessment: making it happen in the classroom

required.description: A description or transcript of the student's work — what they produced
The criteria or rubric the work should be assessed against
What the student was supposed to learn or demonstrate

optional.description: From context engine: prior attainment, known strengths and gaps
The task the student was completing

fields.description: Specific gaps identified, classified by type — conceptual, procedural, or communication
What the student does well — specific, evidence-based strengths
Targeted actions to address each gap — not generic advice but specific next steps
How to communicate the analysis to the student in a way that promotes improvement
